newsitem.title: USA: AMEX to trade options on Technitrol.
newsitem.headline: AMEX to trade options on Technitrol.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange (AMEX) said on Wednesday it would begin trading options on Technitrol Inc on Thursday, March 6.
The AMEX said the options would have opening strike prices of 20, 22-1/2 and 25, with position limits of 4,500 contracts.
Initial expirations are set for March, April, July and October.
The exchange said GHM Inc has been named the specialist unit for the new options. ((Derivatives desk, 3124088750/Email: derivatives@reuters.com))
